one_line: A multilingual scholar-scribe moving between Persianate madrasas and Jain manuscript networks in fifteenth‑century Malwa.

appearance.age_look: mid-20s, slim but slightly stooped from desk work, with the calm posture of a bookish intellectual
appearance.face: oval face, wheat-brown complexion, fine straight nose, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, soft but sharp dark eyes with thin arched brows; default expression is focused and thoughtful, often with a faint half-smile as if quietly analysing a text
appearance.hair: dark brown hair kept short and tidy under a simple off‑white Persianate cap (kulah) with a narrow band and a small, flat crown, the cap slightly tilted back to show a subtle hairline at the temples
appearance.costume: He wears a long, ankle‑length, front‑opening Persianate robe (qabā) in muted indigo blue cotton, with a narrow V-neck, small cloth buttons down the chest, and long sleeves that narrow at the wrists; beneath it a light cream‑coloured, knee‑length tunic and loose, straight trousers in soft beige, both in plain-woven cotton; around his waist a dusty maroon cloth belt (patka) knotted to one side, its loose end hanging to mid‑thigh; on his shoulders a narrow, off‑white woollen shawl with a simple brown edge stripe that can be draped or used as a head wrap when travelling; his feet are in plain dark brown leather mojari shoes with slightly upturned toes, minimally decorated; the overall look is modest, practical scholar’s clothing plausible for Mandu and its networks, with subtle Persianate lines but simple textiles befitting a working scribe, not a grand courtier.
appearance.signature: A medium-sized, worn leather manuscript satchel in dark brown with a wrap-around strap, visibly stuffed with two kinds of bound manuscripts—long, narrow palm-leaf bundles tied with red cord and slightly larger paper codices wrapped in cloth—plus a wooden pen case tucked under the flap, which he often cradles protectively in one arm.

ref_desc: A wheat-brown, oval-faced young scholar with a short beard, dark eyes, a tilted off-white cap, wearing an indigo cotton qabā over cream tunic and beige trousers with a dusty maroon waist belt and brown mojari shoes, carrying a dark brown manuscript satchel stuffed with palm-leaf and paper codices.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of a fifteenth-century Mandu scholar-scribe: a slim, mid-20s man with a wheat-brown complexion, oval face, fine nose, dark attentive eyes, thin arched brows, and a neat short beard and moustache, his expression calm and thoughtful. His dark brown hair is short and mostly hidden under a simple off-white Persianate cap with a narrow band and flat crown, slightly tilted back from his forehead. He wears an ankle-length, front-opening indigo blue cotton qabā with a V-neck, small cloth buttons, and long fitted sleeves; beneath it show hints of a light cream knee-length tunic and loose beige straight trousers. Tie a dusty maroon cloth belt at his waist with the end hanging to mid-thigh, and drape a narrow off-white shawl with a thin brown edge stripe over his shoulders. On his feet are plain dark brown leather mojari shoes with a gentle upturn at the toe and minimal decoration. His signature prop is a worn dark brown leather manuscript satchel slung at his side or cradled in one arm, clearly stuffed with long palm-leaf bundles tied with red cords and slightly larger wrapped paper codices, plus a visible wooden pen case under the flap. Emphasize historical, modest clothing, no fantasy elements, and a restrained palette of indigo, cream, beige, dusty maroon, and dark brown, showing him from multiple angles to capture the fixed face, cap, robe, belt, shoes, and satchel consistently.
